units: <cite ref="Megillah 6a:12-15">Meg. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>זו קסרי … שהיתה מ׳ של מלכים</he> that is Caesarea … for she became the residence of (the Roman) governors; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1">Lam. R. to I, 5</cite> [read:] <he>נעשית קסרין מ׳</he> (strike out <he>ותנופילין</he>) Caesarea became &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 92:8">Gen. R. s. 92</cite> <he>מטרפ׳ היתה וכ׳</he> it was a metropolis and you say, ‘they returned to the town’!; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 42">Gen. R. s. 42</cite>, v. <cite ref="A01849"><he>אֱלֶיוְתְּרוֹפּוֹלִיס</he></cite>.]
